items.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity desktop application screenshot design for BoxHaven, a macOS app for remote development boxes. Flat straight-on 16:10 landscape full app window, crisp readable typography, no physical monitor, no perspective, no exterior presentation text. This is a real working tool, not a marketing website. Minimal text: named buttons, box names, short machine statuses and terminal content only. Narrow left sidebar about 230px, large right terminal workspace. Small tasteful happy smiling server-boxes icon beside BoxHaven wordmark, macOS traffic lights. Sidebar: New box button, search, four rows api-cleanup (Online, selected), dashboard (Online), docs-refresh (Creating), nightly-tests (Offline). Machine liveness only, never claim agent progress. Footer connection/settings icon. Main compact header api-cleanup with pencil rename icon, small secondary metadata 'DigitalOcean · nyc3 · small', 'Open preview ↗' button, disconnect icon, overflow menu. Destruction belongs in overflow, not a giant destructive button. Right pane is a genuine monospaced terminal, not chat bubbles or an editor. Terminal content: '$ npm test', '✓ auth.test.ts (12)', '✓ boxes.test.ts (8)', '20 tests passed', blank line, '$ git status --short', 'M src/routes/boxes.ts', 'M tests/boxes.test.ts', blank line, 'boxhaven@api-cleanup ~/project $' and cursor. Lots of breathing room in terminal, compact deliberate navigation. No cards across main workspace, no charts, no marketing, no gradients, no decorative illustrations beyond tiny app icon. Make it attractive, polished and implementable. Direction A: Warm graphite. Refined dark native Mac utility. Soft warm charcoal sidebar #242321 and almost-black warm terminal #171817. Cream text, muted amber selected accent, tiny sage status lights. Sidebar rows are compact flat rows, not big outlined cards. Amber narrow selection indicator plus very subtle filled row. Delicate dividers, finely aligned icons, professional restrained density. Integrated slim titlebar, terminal visually fills almost the whole right side.
